A '''vibroknuckler''' or '''vibro knuckler''' was a weapon that was worn on an [[Sentience/Legends|individual's]] [[Limb/Legends|fist]] and provided the wielder's punches with extra power. The [[Sayormi]] possessed a variant of this weapon known as the [[Sayormi Heartstriker/Legends|Sayormi Heartstriker]].

==Description==
[[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Arms']] vibroknuckler was a small, easily concealable self-defense weapon. Designed to appeal to individuals who preferred to fight with their fists, the vibroknuckler was slipped over the fingers. Clenching the hand into a fist activated the attached [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]]; although it was a short blade, it was virtually impossible for an opponent to block.<ref name="EGWT" /> An experienced hand to hand fighter could deliver horrific and potentially fatal wounds to their opponent while wielding vibroknucklers.<ref name="DC" />

Vibroknucklers were powered by micro [[Power cell/Legends|power cells]] built into the weapon.<ref name="EGWT" /> They were light, weighing half a [[Kilogram/Legends|kilogram]], and cost between two hundred<ref name="CWCG" /> and three hundred and fifty [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="DC" /> Many citizens of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] carried vibroknucklers,<ref name="NEGWT">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> most commonly thugs and petty [[Thief/Legends|thieves]].<ref name="CWCG" />
